verdict.rationale: Replit documents a first-party Replit MCP Server that a compatible external client, such as a user's own coding agent, can connect to in order to create, find, inspect, or update Replit Apps. That gives an outside agent a path to drive projects, but the evidence is a single thin line. It does not show whether the external agent operates the builder alongside or instead of Replit Agent. The other MCP items cover Replit Agent acting as a client to other tools, so they are not credited here. Missing for 10: detail on what operations the MCP server exposes for editing and iterating, evidence of an external agent working alongside or replacing the built-in Agent, setup and auth documentation, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
